title: Instructions for the Tabernacle and the Ark
description: The Lord spoke to Moses on the mountain and gave detailed instructions on how the Israelites were to bring an offering of gold, silver, bronze, wool, linen, and other materials to build a sanctuary where God could dwell among them. Moses received precise measurements and descriptions for the ark made of acacia wood overlaid with gold, the mercy seat with two cherubim, the table for the bread of the Presence, and the seven-branched lampstand of pure gold. Everything was to be made according to the pattern shown to Moses on the mountain.
